label: A distinct CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining cause of a thing's esse is one it depends on for its being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (sustaining sibling of 2068f91c): in the given model, if c, distinct from x, causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse, DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION at esse) and, in every history in which x is present at some moment, c gives x being at every moment at which x is present (CAUSE_OF_BEING_2, SustainsBeing; GivesAt on the STRICT esse-giving reading of definition 158301bc), then x depends for its being on c (DependsForBeing x c, DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING: x would not be if c were not; a primitive parameter, not time-indexed). It is 2068f91c with the added sustaining antecedent, so 2068f91c entails it (registered strength order); strictly weaker (Control part 1: in a parent-child interpretation the originating parent sustains nothing, so the sibling holds vacuously while 2068f91c fails with dependence read as co-presence). Derived from the contact principle c4661518 and the co-presence bridge; with the weak sustaining reading ce55210c it gives 2068f91c back. It removes the origin-without-sustaining counterexample (a parent and a child) from the dependence step: that case does not satisfy its antecedent.
